baseline.quality: project canonical row-Q4 teacher with FP16 KV
baseline.memory: same project row-Q4 weight accounting + FP16 KV + same reference workspace

diagnostics.interpretation: finer sub-row scale grouping is better supported than depth-wise dithering

conversion_findings.teacher_320_constant_lr_control: not a convergence ceiling; same constant LR produced worse NLL, so convergence-controlled schedule remains open

claim_boundary: Run 5 re-establishes the >=10x gate only at controlled L2C against the project's simple row-Q4 baseline: modeled tensor memory is 11.30x at context 64 and 10.86x at 8K, while five-seed mean perplexity is 1.047x that same row-Q4 baseline. Absolute mean perplexity remains 1.377x the FP32 teacher. This is not Q4_K_M parity, not an external pretrained LLM result, and not measured RAM/VRAM.
